decision.reason: [ev-7a3fdefaaff7] says only that "the service account template" was fixed to incorporate boolean annotation values. It doesn't name the Helm values key or say which service account templates are affected. The proposed exposure, serviceAccount.annotations set, comes from no evidence. It is also broader than the change: it would flag every environment with any service account annotation, not only those with boolean-valued annotations. Deciding this needs the PR #7698 template diff or the chart values diff, showing which values key(s) and templates changed and how boolean values were handled before the fix.
